title.zh: Anthropic IPO：收入增长与上市待定
title.en: Anthropic IPO: Growth and Pending Approval

excerpt.zh: Anthropic IPO材料披露了截至2026年第三季度的收入、客户和亏损数据，并列出预期发行安排；注册声明尚未生效，定价和交易仍取决于监管审批与市场情况。
excerpt.en: Anthropic IPO materials report third-quarter 2026 revenue, customer growth and losses, with a proposed timetable. The registration statement is not yet effective, and pricing and trading remain subject to regulatory

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Anthropic IPO材料公布了公司计划中的公开发行安排和一组业务数据，呈现出快速扩张与显著财务波动并存的局面。材料称，公司拟发行A类普通股，计划在纳斯达克以“ANT”为代码交易；不过，这些安排仍以监管程序推进为前提。
text.en: Anthropic's IPO materials outline a planned public offering alongside business figures that show rapid expansion and significant financial volatility. The company says it plans to offer Class A common stock on Nasdaq under the symbol “ANT,” but the timetable remains conditional on regulatory progress.

text.zh: Anthropic IPO材料显示增长强劲，也披露亏损
text.en: Anthropic IPO figures show growth alongside a large loss

text.zh: 材料列出的2026年第三季度收入为170亿美元，同比增长超过12倍；过去12个月收入至少10万美元的客户超过11,900家，这一客户群也同比增长超过12倍。公司还报告称，自2025年第一季度以来，按收入与计算及基础设施支出之比衡量的计算效率提升超过4倍。
text.en: For the third quarter of 2026, the materials report $17.0 billion in revenue, more than 12 times the year-earlier figure. They list over 11,900 customers with at least $100,000 in trailing-twelve-month revenue, also up more than 12 times year over year. Anthropic says compute efficiency, measured as revenue relative to compute and infrastructure expenses, improved by more than fourfold since the first quarter of 2025.

text.zh: 这些增长数字并不意味着公司已实现盈利。材料同时列出233亿美元净亏损，其中219亿美元是与可转换票据、衍生负债及SAFE估值变化相关的非现金费用；报告的经营利润率为负3%，而调整后经营利润率为15%。两种利润率口径并不相同，投资者需要查看招股说明书中的定义和调节说明。
text.en: The growth figures do not mean the company is profitable. The materials also report a $23.3 billion net loss, including a $21.9 billion non-cash charge tied to changes in the fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities and SAFEs. Operating margin was negative 3%, while adjusted operating margin was 15%. These are different measures; investors should consult the prospectus for definitions and reconciliation.

text.zh: Anthropic IPO时间表仍待监管放行
text.en: Anthropic IPO timetable remains subject to clearance

text.zh: 网页列出的预期时间表是：路演于11月10日开始，发行价预计在11月18日确定，股票预计于11月19日开始交易，日期均为美国东部时间。材料明确表示，注册声明尚未生效，相关证券在生效前不得出售或接受购买要约；最终定价还取决于监管许可、投资者需求和市场状况。
text.en: The stated tentative schedule has the roadshow beginning November 10, pricing expected on November 18, and trading expected to start November 19, all in U.S. Eastern Time. The materials say the registration statement is not yet effective and that the securities may not be sold, nor offers to buy accepted, before it becomes effective. Final pricing also depends on regulatory clearance, investor demand and market conditions.

text.zh: 公司展示的客户案例涉及法律、制药、零售和企业软件等领域，旨在说明Claude在组织中的应用，但这些案例和指标来自公司发行材料，不能单独证明普遍效果。潜在参与者还应留意，申请股份不保证获得配售；发行价与上市后市场价也可能不同。更完整的风险、财务和发行信息应以正式生效的招股说明书为准。
text.en: Customer examples span legal services, pharmaceuticals, retail and enterprise software, illustrating how Anthropic presents Claude's organizational use. These examples and metrics come from company offering materials and do not by themselves establish results across the market. Applicants are not guaranteed an allocation, and the offering price may differ from the market price after trading begins. The effective prospectus is the relevant source for fuller financial, offering and risk disclosures.
